README.html.summary: ingot A C# framework to programmatically create Minecraft Bedrock Edition packs - because writing mountains of JSON sucks. ✨ Features Simple, Type Safe and Fluent API - Define items, blocks, entities and more with clean C# code Automatic Manifest Generation - Both manifest.json files are created for you Behaviour + Resource Pack Support - Full control over BP and RP with easy linking Script API Ready - Built-in support for JavaScript scripting Compile-Time Logging - Clear feedback during pack generation Extensible - Easy to add your own generators and content types
